description: This file contains unit tests for the ReferralOrder class within the OpenMRS project, specifically testing cloning and copying behaviors of referral orders.

classes.name: ReferralOrderTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the ReferralOrder class in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: copy_shouldCopyAllReferralOrderFields
methods.description: Tests that the copy method correctly copies all fields from a ReferralOrder object.

methods.name: cloneForRevision_shouldSetAllTheRelevantFields
methods.description: Ensures that the cloneForRevision method sets all fields appropriately, including metadata and relationships.

methods.name: cloneForDiscontinuing_shouldSetAllTheRelevantFields
methods.description: Verifies that cloning for discontinuing an order copies relevant data and sets the action to DISCONTINUE.

methods.name: cloneForRevision_shouldSetTheRelevantFieldsForADCOrder
methods.description: Tests that the cloneForRevision method resets specific fields such as auto-expiry and accession number.
